behaviors.description: Incoming, grouped, warped and crossing waves use the retained hash/noise and amplitude constants with actual continuous bed/shore inputs.
behaviors.selection: Invoked by the tracked WaterSystem application and its presentation/query consumers.

checks.expectation: Incoming, grouped, warped and crossing waves use the retained hash/noise and amplitude constants with actual continuous bed/shore inputs.
checks.procedure: Compare deterministic noise and waveform samples, shallow gain and normal finite differences; check tide composition, actual shore distance and animation while player input is idle.
